summary: Iteration 41 — Verified (a) default landing tab now Clubhouse, (b) upgraded Clubhouse composer with image + video attachments and mutual-exclusion, (c) director moderation shortcuts (delete + mute) preserved, and (d) rounds/standings/ledger/chip regressions all intact. Backend pytest 10/10 for POST /api/leagues/{id}/feed contract (empty→400 with correct detail, image-only ok, video-only ok, combined echo, GET returns image_path/video_path, non-member rejected, director mute persists). Frontend Playwright: DEFAULT_LANDING → tab-clubhouse active w/ bg-emerald-600 and clubhouse-tab visible without ?tab=. TAB_OVERRIDE → ?tab=rounds still lands on Rounds and shows rounds-empty-state + new-round-btn + 4 league-chip-* nodes. Composer text-only post appears in feed with Director QA name/timestamp. post-image-btn attaches image and post-media-preview renders with post-media-clear removing it. Submit with text+image produces feed-post-image-{id} at top of feed. post-video-btn shows <video> preview; picking Photo after Video (and vice versa) clears the previous attachment (verified via DOM inspection: exactly one of img/video preview at a time). Video-post render was validated via API-injected video_path (real Cloudinary upload of a synthetic mp4 payload was skipped — not a product bug; the composer preview + submit UX is verified). MODERATION: as director, delete-btns render on every non-hidden post; mute btn renders ONLY on posts by other members (feed-mute-btn-<playerPostId> count=1). Clicking delete flips the post into hidden mode (feed-post-hidden-{id} REMOVED badge appears in place of removal — matches spec allowance). Clicking mute on the player's post hits POST /api/leagues/{id}/mute/{uid} and succeeds (no error toast). As non-director member, delete renders only on OWN post (count=1) and mute-btn count=0. PDF/scorecard regression was not deep-navigated (no completed round seeded) but the Rounds tab shell, new-round-btn, chips, and Standings/Ledger tabs all render normally, and RoundScorecard.jsx was not touched by this pass so the P0 invariant from iteration 40 is preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: ClubhouseTab.jsx line 446: <video src> falls back to /api/files/{path} when path does NOT startsWith('http'). This is correct for legacy local storage but /api/files/{path:path} requires an auth query token to stream — a raw <video> tag will not send Authorization header so local-stored videos may fail to load. Cloudinary paths (returned as https:// URLs) work fine. Recommend the AuthImage-equivalent for videos (an <AuthVideo> component that fetches with credentials) OR always store Cloudinary URLs so the video_path is a fully-qualified URL. Not blocking today because Cloudinary is enabled; would be a P1 if the deploy ever falls back to local files.
ClubhouseTab.jsx setInterval(load, 10000) restarts the fetch every 10s even when tab is background — mild waste. Consider pausing on document.hidden.
leagues_clubhouse_router.py FeedPostCreate has no length caps for body/title/image_path/video_path. Not exploited in QA but worth a max_length=2000 on body.

Frontend does not verify server-returned video_path/image_path before mutating feed — relies on optimistic reload. Fine, but the composer disables submit only via postingMedia; if the upload endpoint hangs, the button stays disabled — no explicit timeout / error toast is shown for a stalled upload. Minor UX gap.
